source_record.description:
What we do

AI is redefining how companies compete. Most organizations know they need to transform but only few know how to realize it. As AI Transformation Manager at Merantix Momentum, you are the person who bridges that gap: turning strategic ambition into lasting organizational change.

Merantix Momentum is developing the next generation of impact-driven AI. As a Berlin-based startup, we are driving enterprise AI transformations across industries by building and deploying B2B solutions, orchestrating scaled, AI-native operations. We work across several domains including automotive, manufacturing, healthcare, and others, transforming businesses through ML using our core expertise in state-of-the-art machine learning. Our start-up DNA defines the way we drive rapid value creation with a humble, diverse, and hungry team.


Your role

As an AI Transformation Manager at Merantix Momentum, you bring deep domain and consulting experience to lead clients through end-to-end AI transformation, from identifying strategic opportunities to driving organizational and technical change at scale. You are equally comfortable leading a focused 6-week engagement with a 500-person Mittelstand manufacturer as well as a multi-phase transformation with a large enterprise. You act as a trusted sparring partner to executives, steer complex transformation programs across functions, and bridge the gap between technical possibilities and business imperatives.

You support our business growth by contributing to lead conversion, proposal writing, and pre-sales activities with entrepreneurial energy. With a strong presence and an opinionated point of view, you represent Merantix Momentum’s AI Transformation perspective externally through expert discussions, LinkedIn content, and thought leadership in our core verticals.

Internally, you contribute to the continuous development of our AI Transformation offering by evolving expertise, methods, and tools, leading by example with a fast-paced, can-do attitude and high degree of self-assurance. You are fluent in modern AI trends and applied technology and you can educate, challenge, and influence stakeholders with credibility and confidence.

You don't just advise on AI: you understand how it truly works. You are fluent in modern AI capabilities and can explain how AI capabilities, products, and bespoke Machine Learning solutions are built. This allows you to credibly champion solutions, evaluate investment choices, navigate technical trade-offs, and convince key stakeholders of AI's transformative value.

Your main responsibilities will include the following:

  • Lead AI Transformation Programs: Steer the end-to-end execution of AI transformation engagements — from first lighthouse use case to company-wide rollout. Find the internal champions, manage the blockers, build multi-threaded stakeholder relationships, and drive measurable adoption and organizational change.

  • Support Key Account Growth: Convert pipeline opportunities into growing account relationships and multi-layered transformation programs with the Sales team; support pre-sales, proposal writing, and key-account expansion with an entrepreneurial mindset.

  • Thought Leadership & Advocacy: Represent Merantix Momentum's opinion on AI transformation by inspiring and challenging stakeholders with opinionated, hands-on perspectives on applied AI trends, real-world adoption pathways, and what it actually takes to move from pilot to scale.

  • Advance the AI Transformation practice: Evolve our methodologies, tools, and frameworks to keep our offering state-of-the-art and to develop reusable transformation playbooks, bringing in consulting or domain expertise into the team.

  • Enable Colleagues: Advise colleagues on AI transformation best practices by leading project teams, sharing lessons learned, and contributing to a fast-paced, can-do culture.

When applying please include a cover letter explaining your fit and motivation for this role as AI Transformation Manager.


Your profile

At our heart, we remain a startup and define ourselves by a culture of ownership and cooperation. We are looking for driven, capable, and prudent talents with a strong motivation and hunger for new challenges and opportunities to learn and grow.

  • You are a team player and willing to learn, support and grow in a team and as a company.

  • Preferably 8+ years of full-time working experience in management consulting, enterprise technology, AI/ML-driven companies, or other fast-paced environments like leading startups and boutique consulting firms.

  • Proven experience leading complex, cross-functional transformation programs with the ability to manage executive stakeholders and drive organizational change.

  • Strong fluency in advising on AI, orchestrating its build, operating a model allowing organizations to scale AI, and enabling management to make the right investments.

  • Knowledgeable about common machine learning techniques and trends; experience in AI use case conceptualization and assessing technical feasibility.

  • Demonstrated experience in change management and embedding AI capabilities within client organizations.

  • Curiosity to constantly explore and learn about new AI solutions at the intersection of technology and business.

  • Great communication skills in German and English.


What we offer

You will become part of a highly capable and motivated team driven by a joint mission and eager to learn and grow with and from each other. We are an international and diverse team always supporting and challenging each other to get out the best in each of us. Become part of the entire Merantix ecosystem at the AI Campus in Berlin and join us on transforming the European AI landscape.

  • Engaging Topics and Excellence: Merantix offers unique insights into applied machine learning research and development, working with a group of highly talented engineers, researchers and entrepreneurs

  • Dynamic working culture: We hold weekly and monthly events around AI Innovation and Implementation. We have a flat hierarchy, open 360° feedback, and flexible working hours. We have a flexible work-from-home policy but you are very welcome to work from our office situated on the AI Campus in Berlin.

  • Learning and Development: Individual learning and development budget to attend conferences or purchase educational resources to further develop additional skills. Extra amount of vacation for Learning and Development.

  • Ethics: We are committed to developing ethical AI software.

  • Hardware allowance: We give you support to have all the equipment you would need to thrive on your job.

  • Sabbatical Leave.

  • Add-ons: We offer 50€ per employee per month that can be allocated as desired to one of the following: Mobility & transportation (NAVIT), Sport (Urban Sports Club membership) or groceries (Edenred).
